title: Joining Charlie Creath's riverboat band, 1919
summary: Back from the army he is sent by Eddie Allen to Charlie Creath, who hires him on the boat; the band plays dressed-up stock arrangements.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: And when I came out of the army in 1919, Charlie Crisp was in St. Louis. Well he had set St. Louis on fire. He was working on the boat. And he wanted a trumpet player. Well Eddie Allen, who knew me before I went in on me, after coming home, he said, why don't you go down and see Charlie Crisp? But I said, well I can't play that kind of music. I said, well I know it's just straight legit music. So he said, well you go down and see Charlie. Well I wasn't seeing Charlie. And Charlie had me play the first night on the boat. He said, you've got everything and I'm going to make you one of the world greatest jazz trumpet players.
Did they use written arrangements in his band or?
No, they, it was regular stock arrangements but you dressed them up. You know what I mean?
I mean they used music though, they didn't just play with the ear in Paris.
